all_clique_count.note: Number of cliques of G (vertex sets inducing complete graphs), the empty one included: #|cliques [set: G]|. K_0 gives 1.

nonempty_clique_count.note: Number of nonempty cliques; one less than all_clique_count (nonempty_clique_countS). K_0 gives 0.

clique_count_size.note: Number of cliques with exactly r vertices; 1 at r = 0, #|G| at r = 1, #|E(G)| at r = 2, 0 above the order; r = 3 counts triangles.
